decisions.assessment: The PVP-iodine complex is identified, not elemental iodine or alcohol-based iodine tincture. Chinese says it is the ingredient in common iodophor preparations, not an assertion all branded iodine products have identical formulations. CDC complex description independently read.
Single-use product noun; no automatic sterile/material/protection equivalence. Sizes in the original example agree.
Disposable-mask product noun without implying surgical classification or universal filtration performance.
Selected body-temperature context is explicit; digital refers to numerical display and is not a claim of a universal measurement site.
Generic syrup preparation for cough, not one active ingredient; receipt example makes no efficacy or dosage claim.
Nasal liquid-spray product, not a lung inhaler; no claim that every spray contains the same drug.
Generic motion-sickness medication; nausea in moving transport rather than a specific car-only drug. No recommendation or dose supplied.
Immune-mediated allergy is kept separate from all adverse effects; MedlinePlus distinction independently read. Original history-record example makes no diagnosis.
Medicine-label expression rather than a universal interval instruction. NHS SPS label usage independently read; example asks the pharmacist what label wording means.
Food-associated administration label, distinct from physically mixing medicine into food or universally after a meal. Original example quotes a label.
Patient health/encounter record, paper or electronic; no claim of universal record access procedure.
Appointment after prior care, not guaranteed further treatment; Thursday-afternoon rescheduling preserved in Chinese.
Selected tree-nut/cashew context explicitly scoped; peanuts are not automatically equated. Canadian primary source independently read; no claim that every tree nut necessarily triggers the person.
Peanut-specific allergy kept separate from tree nuts; no cross-tolerance advice or guarantee.
Service explicitly means public transport, bus or train without guessing one. Example describes hurrying to avoid missing it, not already missing it.

scope: Vocabulary and original bilingual examples only; no treatment, dosage or personalised medical advice.
